flagship.name: Architecture-as-Memory
flagship.description: Local-first architectural memory for AI-assisted development. Models system boundaries through declarative YAML, visualizes repository topology, and validates architectural relationships through CLI workflows.

flagship.name: PromptNova
flagship.description: An AI prompt-engineering workbench for transforming raw intent into structured prompts. Combines agent refinement workflows, multi-perspective evaluation, and an interactive interface for developing and testing prompts.

flagship.name: ContractGraph
flagship.description: Claude Code-native contract-driven workflows. Compiles context and JSON Schema contracts into scoped agent DAGs, with independent verification gates and targeted node repair.

flagship.name: CredFlow
flagship.description: A full-stack telecom billing and collections application with automated dunning rules, invoice workflows, and role-based operational dashboards. Integrates Spring Boot services, relational persistence, and AI-assisted features.
